_comment: Mutation gate. `mutate` is scoped to src production files; the web UI and test files are never mutated. `ignorePatterns` keeps research_repos out of the sandbox copy.

Exclusion rule: a module whose body is a real I/O boundary is excluded, and every decision it used to hold is extracted into a pure module that stays mutated. An exclusion without one is a coverage gap in disguise. Each entry names that pairing as it lands.
src/cli/main.ts - process entry: error mapping, exit codes and serve wiring; covered by the integration and e2e tiers.
